difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian local domain with normal completion, every sequence of normalized blowups over the completion is the base change of a sequence of proper normalized blowups over the original ring (statement lines 3235-3243). The proof (proof lines 3244-3262) is an induction matching the closed points blown up through the isomorphism of the closed fibres and descending the normalization step. H2: a complete induction.
